children: TORONTO, Nov. 25, 2026 /CNW/ -- Grey Wolf Health Corp. (

) ("Grey Wolf" or the "Company"), a Canadian diversified health company, today announced financial results for the three- and nine- months ended September 30, 2026. All results are reported in Canadian dollars.
Revenue for the quarter increased year over year by 9.6% to $10.2 million. Revenue increased by 10.4% to $29.6 million for the first nine months of the year.
Gross profit increased year over year by 14.8% to $5.6 million for the quarter and 12.8% to $16.2 million for the first nine months of the year.
Adjusted EBITDA1 increased year over year by 24.6% to $2.4 million for the quarter and by 9.7% to $5.9 million for the first nine months of the year.

"Grey Wolf delivered another solid quarter for both revenue and Adjusted EBITDA," said Angela Cechetto, Chief Executive Officer. "Our Pharmacy business grew organically year-over-year by 9.4% to $6.3 million due to an increase in sales of compounded products during the quarter. Meanwhile, our Animal Health business was up 10.1% year-over-year to $3.9 million in the quarter due to increased sales of established and new products, particularly in our gastrointestinal, behavior and end-of-life portfolios. Even as we continue to invest in key initiatives to advance our growth strategy, we saw Adjusted EBITDA1 increase year to date versus 2025 by 9.7% to $5.9 million as a result of higher revenue and gross profits."
Key Financial Data and Comparative Results
Results of Operations for the Three- and Nine- Months ended September 30, 2026

Total revenue for the three- and nine- month periods ended September 30, 2026 increased 9.6% to $10.2 million and 10.4% to $29.6 million, respectively, compared to the same period in 2025. Revenue in the Pharmacy business increased by 9.4% to $6.3 million and 9.2% to $18.7 million respectively, compared to the same three- and nine- month periods in 2025 due to growth in sales of compounded products. In the Animal Health business, revenue grew year over year by 10.1% to $3.9 million and 12.6% to $10.9 million, respectively, in the three- and nine- month periods in 2026 due to increased sales in established and new products.

Gross profit margins for the three- and nine- month periods ended September 30, 2026 increased to 55.1% from 52.7% and 55.0% from 53.8%, respectively, compared to the same periods in 2025. Gross profits were impacted by increased margins in the Animal Health business unit as a result of product mix, and increased margins in the Pharmacy business unit as a result of decreased material costs offset by increased overhead and depreciation expenses.

Total expenses for the three- and nine- month periods ended September 30, 2026, increased 15.4% to $4.3 million and 16.0% to $12.9 million, respectively, over the same periods in 2025. During the nine-month period, there was an increase in salary, bonuses, and benefits related to operational growth, an increase in professional and outside services in support of the ERP implementation, and an increase in freight and other expenses.

Adjusted EBITDA1 for the three- and nine- month periods ended September 30, 2026 increased 24.6% to $2.4 million and 9.7% to $5.9 million, compared to the same periods in 2025. Adjusted EBITDA1 was impacted by an increase in net income, an increase in the add back of income tax and depreciation expenses and offset by foreign exchange losses and one-time implementation costs for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Cash and cash equivalents were $10.2 million at September 30, 2026 compared to $7.7 million at December 31, 2025. The Company generated cash from operations of $4.1 million, which was primarily impacted by net income for the current period and by changes in non-cash working capital items, most significantly changes in trade and other receivables and accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

As at September 30, 2026, the Company had outstanding borrowings of $23.6 million, of which $7.5 million are current and $16.1 million are non-current. The Company repaid borrowings of $0.5 million in the quarter and $1.5 million since December 31, 2025. The Company's debt consists of three fixed rate term loans, including a mortgage of $4.3 million secured against our Manitoba facility. On August 19, 2026, the Company signed an extension for the CWB credit loan having a balance of $6.5 million at September 30, 2026 under the same terms and conditions, until August 31, 2027.

Management uses both IFRS and Non-IFRS Measures to assess the financial and operating performance of the Company's operations. These Non-IFRS Measures are not recognized measures under IFRS, do not have a standardized meaning under IFRS and are unlikely to be comparable to similar measures presented by other companies. The Non-IFRS Measures referenced in this press release includes Adjusted EBITDA. The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA as earnings before transaction costs (including, for greater certainty, transaction costs related to the CPM Acquisition), one-time implementation costs, interest income, interest and accretion expense, income taxes, depreciation of property and equipment, depreciation of right of use assets, amortization of intangible assets, share-based compensation, foreign exchange gains or losses. The Company considers Adjusted EBITDA as an additional metric in assessing business performance and an important measure of operating performance and cash flow, providing useful information to help analyze and compare profitability between companies for investors and analysts.
